patch_description: Replace the fixed exponentially weighted average with a causal, robust adaptive alpha-beta tracker. The tracker explicitly models both level and local velocity, which reduces lag relative to averaging while preserving sustained trends through one-step prediction. Innovation clipping prevents isolated volatile samples from causing false directional reversals, and a velocity deadband suppresses small noise-driven slope sign changes. The window size is retained as a warm-up/output-alignment parameter and controls the adaptation time constant, preserving the existing API and output length expected by downstream metric alignment.
